population_definition: all kernels in shard FV-PROPFLOOR-SHARD-B3-1, enumerated below by kernel id and spec digest
independence_sentence: Each item listed was reviewed and attested independently; the single signature is a mechanical convenience over the enumerated digests, not a bulk review.
per_item_basis_of_review: Every row ran the same two mechanical checks unconditionally: (1) the fixture-oracle gate — compute() output diffed against the kernel's own existing golden fixtures before any property was trusted, and (2) run-proptests.mjs green (process exit 0). ULP-boundary forcing was mandatory and present for the 1 float-sensitive row named in the WU (art-15-agentic-mandate-sandbox — raw spend-cap doubles pass through into the mandate skeleton and mandate_id derives a Math.round tie-break over those same doubles), checked below. The other 9 rows (art-144, art-145, art-146, art-147, art-151, art-153, art-154, art-159, art-16) are the row's stated float:no exceptions and instead carry forced CATEGORICAL boundary cases (empty arrays/strings, missing optional fields, exact fixed-threshold ties, unrecognized enum values) in place of ULP forcing. No row beyond these two mechanical checks received a separate in-depth human review in this pass — that is exactly the gap human_sign_off.status=PENDING names.
